title: Probabilistic hop sampling with contextual rollups for routing audit
creator: Anya Patel
description: Introduce a probabilistic per-hop sampling mechanism that captures compact contextual snapshots and micro-metrics for routing audits and post-facto replay without blowing up storage or ingestion costs. The approach combines reservoir-style sampling weights, a content signature (contextual rollup) to collapse duplicates, and Bloom-filter deduplication at ingestion. Sampling weight is computed from a tunable SLO-risk score, recent error/latency signals, token-cost estimate, and customer tier. Captured snapshots are delta-encoded micro-metrics + a short context signature (not full payload) and linked to traces via trace_id and route_shard for fast lookup. This ticket covers design, prototype, storage schema, and a gradual rollout plan including per-tenant overrides and UI controls in Console.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end prototype that emits sampled hop snapshots and micro-metrics for 1% of traffic in staging
Snapshots are no larger than 1KB on average after compression and delta-encoding
Ingestion pipeline deduplicates identical context signatures with a false-positive rate <1% (Bloom filter config documented)
Admin UI slider and per-tenant override exist in Console for sampling rate and SLO-weight threshold
Runbook updated: how to enable on-demand snapshot retrieval for a trace and costs explained
No client-visible latency increase >1ms p50 for routing decision path in canary tests
design_notes: Sampling weight formula: w = clamp(base_rate * (1 + slo_risk*alpha + errors*beta + cost_factor*gamma) * tier_multiplier, 0, 1)
Contextual rollup is a stable sha256 over a canonicalized subset of request metadata (model variant, region_hint, requester_tier, token_length_histogram, top_prompt_signature)
Use reservoir sampling per route_shard to ensure rare but important routes are not starved
Store only a context signature + short human-readable hint in the snapshot to avoid PII and reduce size
Micro-metrics are stored as delta-encoded ints (latency_ms, kv_cache_hits, batch_size) and compressed with snappy
Deduplication at ingestion uses a per-minute Bloom filter keyed by context signature + model_variant to collapse identical snapshots across retries
implementation_notes: Runtime hook inserted post-routing-decision to evaluate sampling weight and either emit immediate lightweight snapshot or skip
Emit format: {trace_id, route_shard, timestamp, context_signature, hint_map, deltas_blob, sampling_reason, sampling_weight}
Add an enrichment job that expands the hint_map for on-demand replay (pulls full prompt from secure short-term store if customer authorizes)
Observation store schema will create a compact index on (trace_id, route_shard, context_signature) for fast lookups
Telemetry will include counters for sampled_count, deduped_count, storage_bytes, and per-tenant cost_estimate
experiments: Staging run: w=0.01 fixed for two days across 10 tenants to measure snapshot size distribution and ingestion QPS
A/B: compare reservoir vs pure-probabilistic sampling to validate representation of rare routes
Sensitivity sweep for bloom filter size to hit <1% false positive while bounding memory to 256MB per ingester shard
Cost simulation to verify long-tail storage stays within budget under 5x traffic spike

decisions: Do not include full prompt text in snapshots by default; use a secure short-term store with explicit retrieval
Use reservoir sampling per route_shard instead of a global reservoir to preserve rare route visibility
Bloom filter deduplication will run at ingester level with a configurable retention window (default 1 minute)
Sampling weight will be exposed as a debug field so telemetry can attribute why a snapshot was taken
